statement: The proposed scale-uniform strengthening M01, namely that every actual c=1 (++ -> ++) state with gamma4<0 satisfies e>=binom(a-1,3) when alpha=binom(a,2)+s, is false. The actual state (j,h,q,k,r,u,b)=(7,7168,4845,4,204,207,4849) has alpha=1524=binom(55,2)+39 and e=18356<binom(54,3)=24804. At the same state the weaker G++ margin U_3(e)-U_2(alpha)-1 is 183083 and gamma5 is 245481, so the counterexample kills only the cubic strengthening, not G++ or two-row recovery.
closes: the M01 cubic-digit-gap route to a scale-uniform proof of G++
the inherited proposed reduction from G++ to e>=binom(a-1,3)
dependency_gaps: G++ itself remains open because the nonlinear raise U_3(e) can dominate U_2(alpha) even when e<binom(a-1,3)
M08 remains unproved: gamma5 negativity has not been shown universally to force P,V>=0
M09 remains unproved: gamma6 positivity has only finite evidence on the no-borrow negative branch
actual c=1 chamber exhaustion and the public antichain interface remain open
